findings.title: init() enables the client without TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL, contradicting T1.2's four-required-keys spec and AC1's StatusCallback contract
findings.evidence:
case sid, token, alpha_sender {
    Some(sid), Some(token), Some(alpha_sender) ->
      Enabled(TwilioConfig(
        account_sid: sid,
        auth_token: token,
        alpha_sender:,
        status_callback_base_url: base_url |> option.unwrap(""),
      ))
findings.detail: T1.2 lists TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL among the four required keys and says Disabled when any is absent; AC1 mandates a StatusCallback URL on every send. Code checks only sid/token/alpha_sender and keeps the client Enabled with an empty base URL, so sends omit StatusCallback. Code documents the choice, but the spec was not amended.
findings.recommended_fix: Either require TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL in init() (Disabled when absent) to match T1.2, or amend T1.2/AC1 to mark StatusCallback conditionally optional.

findings.title: build_lookup_request is @internal exposed for tests but has no unit test (asymmetric with build_send_request)
findings.detail: The GET request assembly (method, Basic auth header, %2B-encoded URL) is exposed @internal for tests but lookup_test.gleam never references it, while build_send_request has two tests. Pure-builder coverage sits at the CONCERNS boundary (~90%).
findings.recommended_fix: Add a build_lookup_request test asserting GET, the Basic auth header, and the %2B-encoded URL (mirror the build_send_request tests).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.evidence: sms_client_test.gleam covers build_send_form_body, build_messages_url, status_callback_url, basic_auth_header, parse_send_response, send_sms(Disabled), build_send_request; lookup_test.gleam covers parse_line_type, build_lookup_url, no-op, voip.
findings.detail: In-scope pure builders/parse/no-op ~90% (one gap: build_lookup_request). The HTTP dispatch envelopes (do_send/do_lookup) and their error branches are 0% covered at unit and integration level; spec defers that to integration when callers arrive in rc3-5/rc3-7.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the build_lookup_request test now; cover do_send/do_lookup failure paths via integration tests when rc3-5/rc3-7 wire callers.

findings.title: Lookup failure messages embed the raw applicant phone number (PII) into Sentry
findings.evidence:
capture_failure(
            sentry,
            message: "Invalid Twilio Lookup URL for phone " <> phone,
...
                message: "Twilio Lookup HTTP "
                  <> int.to_string(status)
                  <> " for phone "
                  <> phone,
findings.detail: Every lookup failure writes the full E.164 applicant phone into the Sentry message; AC5's stated context is status/error-kind/endpoint tags. Codebase precedent (trigger.gleam) captures app_id, not raw PII, and truncate_message only caps length, it does not redact. GDPR-heavy app.
findings.recommended_fix: Redact the phone in Sentry messages (e.g. last 4 digits only), keep the full number in local logs; mirror the app_id-style capture used in reference_checks/trigger.gleam.

findings.title: do_send logs HTTP/connection failures locally but not parse/build failures
findings.detail: HTTP-status and connection failures call both capture_failure and wisp.log_error, but the 2xx-but-unparseable and request-build failure branches only capture to Sentry with no local log_error. Inconsistent error visibility.
findings.recommended_fix: Add wisp.log_error to the decode-failure and build-failure branches, or route every failure through one capture+log helper.

findings.title: status_callback_url does naive concat; a trailing slash on TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL yields a //webhooks/twilio-sms path
findings.detail: Empty base is guarded (omits callback) but a trailing slash is not. base="https://host/" produces "https://host//webhooks/twilio-sms", which may 404 on the rc3-6 route, silently losing every delivery callback. .env.example default has no trailing slash, so this needs misconfiguration to trigger.
findings.recommended_fix: Trim a trailing '/' from base before concat (normalize in init(), or guard in status_callback_url).

findings.title: T1.4 specifies parsing sid/status; only sid is decoded
findings.detail: T1.4 says parse sid/status, but parse_send_response decodes only sid and SendOutcome carries no status. The Twilio response status (queued/failed) is never read. No current consumer needs it (rc3-6 webhooks carry delivery status), so low impact.
findings.recommended_fix: Decode and expose status (log it, or add it to SendOutcome), or amend T1.4 to drop the status requirement.

findings.title: form_encode is re-implemented in sms_client instead of reusing a shared encoder; stripe_client keeps the + bug
findings.detail: Two form-encoders now exist; the corrected (+ to %2B) copy lives only in notification while payment/stripe_client retains the latent gap. The story spec documents this as a known out-of-scope deviation, so it is deliberate, but divergent copies will drift.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract one shared form-encoder (with the + fix) into a common util and reuse it from both stripe_client and sms_client — a later cleanup story.

findings.title: reference_checks/lookup depends on notification/sms_client for shared Twilio credentials and Basic auth
findings.detail: The Twilio config handle, Enabled/Disabled variants, and basic_auth_header live under notification/, so the reference_checks domain reaches into notification for shared infra — coupling two unrelated domains. The spec chose this (same creds, no separate provisioning); a neutral integrations/twilio module would be cleaner.
findings.recommended_fix: Lift the Twilio config/handle/basic_auth into a neutral module (e.g. integrations/twilio); have both sms_client and lookup depend on that.
